Job Title: Data Analyst

 

Job Summary:

 

The Data Analyst plays a crucial role in driving enterprise data enablement across Wealth Management and related service lines. This position helps the organization leverage data, technology, and practical strategies to address diverse business challenges across platforms. As a member of the Data Management team, the Data Analyst collaborates closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence teams to document requirements, support the engineering of data solutions, validate deliverables, and enable users to access, comprehend, and utilize available data products and capabilities. Responsibilities encompass data stewardship, user documentation, management of data catalog content, SQL-driven analysis, and activities supporting data quality, compliance, and regulatory reporting.

 

This role is responsible for evaluating current data products and capabilities against business needs, recommending data and process improvements, and coordinating with teams to implement these enhancements. The Data Analyst independently manages smaller, clearly defined requests and enhancements, while contributing to larger initiatives under the guidance of senior team members. Success in this role is measured by thorough documentation, timely and accurate delivery, effective process improvements, and the empowerment of business users. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment and values a collaborative, family-friendly culture.

 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

 

Data Stewardship & End-User Enablement

 - Enable business users to discover, understand, and appropriately use available data products and tools to address business needs

 - Maintain user documentation, business glossaries, and data catalog content, including definitions, ownership, lineage, appropriate usage, and limitations, in partnership with data owners and technical teams

 - Assist with end-user training, demonstrations, and communications that promote adoption and effective use of data products and tools

 - Collect user feedback, investigate inquiries, evaluate data products and processes against business requirements, recommend improvements, and coordinate implementation efforts

 - Support AI agent development by documenting business use cases, identifying relevant data products, clarifying terminology and rules, and validating outputs in collaboration with technical partners

 

Business Requirements & Delivery Support

 - Partner with business stakeholders and Data Management team members to document detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for new or enhanced data products

 - Collaborate with technical teams to define data fields, business definitions, high-level source-to-target mapping, and business rules

 - Independently manage smaller, clearly scoped requests from requirements gathering through delivery, working with Data Engineering and BI to clarify needs and report on progress

 - Validate data products against requirements, document findings, and work alongside technical teams and business partners to resolve discrepancies as needed

 

Data Analysis, Quality & Governance

 - Use SQL to analyze data, profile datasets, reconcile source and target data, and validate delivered outputs

 - Identify and document data discrepancies, assess potential business impacts, and coordinate investigation and resolution with Data Management and Engineering

 - Define and monitor data quality rules, follow up on identified issues

 - Adhere to established data governance, documentation, access, and handling practices

 - Support compliance and regulatory reporting initiatives through detailed requirements documentation, data validation, traceability, and issue tracking

 

Required Education and Experience:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - 3+ years’ experience in data analysis, business analysis, data stewardship, or a related data-focused role

 - Experience collaborating with business and technical teams to translate business and data requirements into actionable specifications, user stories, or acceptance criteria

 - Demonstrated proficiency with SQL for data querying, investigation, and validation across varied sources

 - Experience supporting data product testing, validation, and/or user acceptance testing

 - Proven ability to create business-facing documentation to help users understand data or analytical solutions

 

Preferred Education and Experience:

 - Experience in Wealth Management, Financial Services, or other regulated industries

 - Familiarity with compliance, regulatory reporting, or controlled data handling practices

 - Experience with data stewardship, metadata management, business glossaries, or data catalog tools

 - Experience operating in agile or hybrid agile environments

 - Experience supporting data process improvements, user training, data product adoption, and/or AI-driven business use cases

 

Skills:

 - Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable data requirements and documentation

 - Strong understanding of relational data, data integration concepts, business rules, and data lineage

 - Proficiency with SQL and cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake); familiarity with dbt is a plus

 - Experience with data platforms and tools such as Snowflake, APIs, Tableau, Power BI, or Alteryx

 - Working knowledge of data catalogs and metadata management tools (e.g., OpenMetadata, Alation, Collibra)

 - Hands-on experience with product management tools (e.g., YouTrack, Jira)

 - Ability to systematically investigate and document data discrepancies, knowing when to escalate issues

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic environments with high levels of ambiguity and autonomy
